bootrom.ts contains the RP2040 B1 bootrom image copied from rp2040js.
rp2040js is MIT-licensed; that does not replace the separate ROM licenses.
Upstream-identified ROM source revision:
https://github.com/raspberrypi/pico-bootrom-rp2040/tree/00a4a19114195e20fb817bdfbca1165e157eef37
Its pinned Pico SDK revision is 26653ea81e340cacee55025d110c3e014a252a87.

The floating-point routines bootrom/mufplib.S and bootrom/mufplib-double.S
are Copyright (c) 2020 Mark Owen https://www.quinapalus.com . Their headers
provide a Raspberry Pi license restricted to physical RP2040-device use,
and state that the software is also available under GPLv2. The restricted
hardware-only alternative is not assumed to cover this software emulator.
The original headers and full GPLv2 text are retained in third_party/licenses/.
Local release packages include the identified source/build archives, including
the pinned SDK, in third_party/sources/. See third_party/README.md and
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. No legal determination about the combined application
or a first-party application license is made by this notice.

Everything else in the bootrom is licensed as follows:
